decisive_quotes.quote: HM Revenue and Customs will tell your employer to stop taking repayments from your salary when you have repaid your loan in full
You can ask for a refund if you have paid more than the total amount you owe.

uk-001-105a10d6-uk-policies-govuk-studen.why: The getting-a-refund page says repayments stop once the loan is repaid in full, and anything paid over the total owed can be refunded. So the net repayment cannot exceed the balance owed. The pre-fix formula returns the full rate × excess income with no upper bound. provision.txt (what-you-pay) gives only the rate and thresholds, which both modules satisfy.

Reader B treats this as an argument about the amount, but the defect is about time: one year's determination is applied across a window that starts in 1975. The quoted sentence conflicts with that directly. The post-fix rule does not have to supply a number to fit the text better. It only has to stop fixing one year's figure for every year.
